metadata.title: Secure DNS

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for asserting that name resolution, naming authority, and DNS-dependent trust decisions are supported by authoritative, bounded, observable, and resilient DNS.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite trust assertion aggregating DNS platform capabilities to support secure name resolution and DNS-dependent trust decisions.

metadata.remarks: Secure DNS is a composite trust assertion stating that DNS used for discovery, service identity binding, integration, and boundary enforcement is authoritative, bounded, observable, and resilient. It introduces no independent controls and exists solely as an aggregate trust claim.

components.title: Platform DNS Core

components.description: Controlled and deterministic name resolution behavior.

components.title: DNS Caching and TTL Behavior
components.description: Predictable and bounded DNS caching semantics.

components.title: DNS Zoning and Views
components.description: Intentional DNS resolution boundaries and split-horizon visibility.

components.title: DNS Resolver Availability and Resilience
components.description: Redundant, resilient, and predictable DNS resolver behavior.

components.title: DNS Observability and Telemetry
components.description: Visibility into DNS behavior to support monitoring and investigation.
